extension.summary: Sports categories, legal Polish sources and direct HLS/DASH playback
extension.description: Framework for Kodi 21 Omega. It keeps Strumyk and Strims24 as configured source pages, adds curated official Polish-language sports sources, and supports direct playback of user-owned or licensed HLS/DASH streams through Kodi's native video player. It does not bypass DRM, authentication, paywalls, or access controls.
